en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buyout acceptance reaches 99.1 per cent as deadline ends
en.dek: By the 5pm Monday cut-off, 1,967 of 1,984 owners had returned acceptance letters, leaving 17 households; the government said it would press ahead with remaining acquisitions.
body: More than 99 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners accepted the government’s buyout offer by the final deadline on Monday, the authorities said.

As of 5pm, 1,967 of the estate’s 1,984 flat owners, or 99.1 per cent, had returned acceptance letters. Among those who accepted, 1,559, or 78.6 per cent, had already signed formal sale and purchase agreements.

The remaining 17 households may face compulsory acquisition at lower compensation levels in the future. A government statement said the authorities would continue to pursue the remaining ownership acquisition procedures at full speed.
The HK$6.8 billion scheme was announced after the November fire that killed 168 people and displaced thousands of residents. Officials have ruled out on-site redevelopment.

zh.headline: 宏福苑收購接受率達99.1% 限期屆滿尚餘17戶
zh.dek: 截至周一傍晚5時截止，1,984戶中有1,967戶交回接受書，比率99.1%；餘下17戶或面對強制收地。
body: 政府表示，宏福苑業主接受收購方案的限期於周一結束，接受比率達99.1%。
截至下午5時，1,984戶業主中有1,967戶已交回接受書。當中1,559戶，即78.6%，已簽訂正式買賣協議。
餘下17戶或會在日後以較低補償水平面對強制收購。政府聲明指會全速推進餘下業權收購程序。
這項約68億元的收購計劃於去年11月火災後公布，火災造成168人死亡，數千居民流離失所。當局已表明不會原址重建。
